# Step - with_path

`with_path` · `withPath` · category: [Modulators and options](../../traversal/step_reference.md#modulators-and-options)

Records full paths for this traversal (TinkerPop's withPath(); path recording is otherwise derived from the query).

## Forms

```text
with_path()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.with_path().v(1).out().path().count().next()   // 3
```
